durable_shape.receipt: Encrypted prepared-intelligence envelope bound to workspace, owner, subject, canonical audience, exact purpose, request identity, authority fingerprint, content fingerprint and expiry.
durable_shape.dependencies: Typed and versioned authority references sharing the exact parent scope.
durable_shape.events: Payload-free accepted and future lifecycle receipts. R10 implements accepted only.
durable_shape.write_boundary: One security-invoker transaction granted to service_role and closed to public, anon and authenticated.
durable_shape.read_boundary: Non-anonymous membership plus exact audience and purpose grant, with expired, invalidated and erased receipts hidden.

negative_controls: removing the authority-fingerprint comparison makes the canary fail
removing the current-authority check makes the canary fail

authority_adapter_boundary.reason: Legacy decision rows have no canonical Brain workspace binding or immutable snapshot fingerprint. Guessing from user_id would weaken R7 scope authority.

remaining_gates: Implement and independently prove real current-authority adapters against the canonical Brain tables.
Define workspace-bound immutable authority for decision cases and claims before enabling those kinds.
Prove the candidate upsert's concurrent replay convergence on a multi-connection PostgreSQL runtime.
Run the candidate and test through Supabase local plus PostgREST when Docker or Podman is available.
Add correction invalidation and erasure transactions before customer data or delivery uses this store.
Review a migration proposal separately before any database application.
bounded_claim: R10 proves the proposed receipt, dependency and event shape plus one atomic write boundary on PostgreSQL 18.3 WASM. It does not provide a live authority adapter, migration, runtime caller, concurrent multi-connection proof, correction or erasure path, Supabase-local parity or production readiness.
